text.p: Mount Lofty Ranges and parts of Adelaide Metropolitan, Mid North, Riverland, Murraylands and Upper South East districts.
The State Emergency Service advises that people should:
* Don't drive, ride or walk through flood water.
* Keep clear of creeks and storm drains.
* Stay indoors, away from windows, while storms are nearby.

warning-info.text: The next warning is due to be issued by 6:20 pm.

text.p: Check https://www.bom.gov.au/weather-and-climate/warnings-and-alerts. Warnings are also available through TV and Radio broadcasts or call 1300 659 210. The Bureau and State Emergency Service would appreciate warnings being broadcast regularly.

Weather Situation: Lines of showers and thunderstorms may result in areas of heavy rainfall extending from the Riverland district through to parts of the southern Fleurieu Peninsula, including eastern Adelaide suburbs.
If severe thunderstorms develop in the Adelaide Region, a more Detailed Severe Thunderstorm Warning will be issued to people in this area.

Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Murray Bridge, Gawler, Victor Harbor, Blanchetown, Mannum and Tailem Bend.
